name: bottom-bar
description: A compact rounded bar at the bottom of the terminal and above the prompt in the desktop and mobile apps (model, effort, context and tokens used, 5-hour and 7-day usage, agents) with a Tools button that opens the Main Menu.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to remove the bar, the pill and the toolbox; the commands then say the bar is off.

name.title: Pill name
name.description: The name shown on the pill and at the top of the toolbox. Default: Tools.

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: The accent colour of the bar, the pill and the toolbox: Coral, Amber, Sage, Sky, Lilac or Rose. Default: Coral.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the bar re-reads the model, usage and agents, from 1 to 60. Default: 4 seconds.

showUsage.title: Show 5-hour and 7-day usage
showUsage.description: Show your 5-hour and 7-day usage figures on the bar. Default: on.

showAgents.title: Show agent count
showAgents.description: Show how many agents are running on the bar. Default: on.

showTodo.title: Show the to-do list
showTodo.description: Draw Claude's to-do list above the bar in the desktop and mobile apps while Claude works. Default: on.
